title: Building Self-Improving Agent Software Factories — Suraj Gupta, Warp
hook: Um my name is Siraj Gupta. I lead Harness development at Warp. Um in case you haven't heard of Warp before, um we started off by building a state-of-the-art agentic development environment. Um we have about a million active users that use that. Um it was born out of a modern-day terminal. Um and nowadays we're building a um cloud agent platform to enable teams to build software…
bullets: 0:22 — ~1M MAU on Warp’s agentic IDE; expanding to a cloud agent platform for teams.
1:10 — Self-improvement loop can be automatic as the software-factory paradigm shifts.
2:28 — Factory skills (e.g. bug reproduction) go stale unless the improvement loop refreshes them.
9:29 — Model routing favors Pareto-efficient defaults instead of users pinning one model.
